title: A Nonlinear Time-Series Theory for Constant-step SGD with Momentum
abstract: arXiv:2610.16034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constant-step stochastic gradient descent with momentum (SGDM) augments the parameter recursion with a momentum state that carries geometrically decaying memory of past stochastic gradients. We study this coupled recursion as a nonlinear time series and develop a framework for its stationary behavior and distributional limits. The joint parameter-momentum process forgets its initialization geometrically under a finite $p$th moment for $p > 1$, yielding a unique stationary causal solution. Under a second-moment condition, this contraction leads to an invariance principle and quenched Gaussian limit for averaged SGDM, while a small-learning-rate analysis gives a Gaussian limit for the last iterate. In a stochastic-curvature quadratic model, we further study how the rate of initialization forgetting relates to stationary variance and averaged fluctuations.

translated_title: 恒定步长带动量随机梯度下降的非线性时间序列理论
translated_abstract: 恒定步长带动量的随机梯度下降（SGDM）通过引入一个动量状态来增强参数递推过程，该动量状态携带对过去随机梯度的几何衰减记忆。我们将这一耦合递推作为一个非线性时间序列进行研究，并为其平稳行为和分布极限开发了一个理论框架。在 $p > 1$ 的有限 $p$ 阶矩条件下，参数-动量联合过程会以几何速度遗忘其初始化，从而产生唯一的平稳因果解。在二阶矩条件下，这种收缩性导出了不变性原理以及平均化 SGDM 的淬火（quenched）高斯极限，而小学习率分析则给出了最后一步迭代的高斯极限。在随机曲率二次模型中，我们进一步研究了初始化遗忘速率与平稳方差及平均化涨落之间的关系。
tldr: 该论文首次将恒定步长带动量的SGDM视为非线性时间序列，证明了参数-动量联合过程的几何遗忘性与唯一平稳因果解的存在性，并由此导出了平均化SGDM的不变性原理、淬火高斯极限以及小学习率下最后迭代的高斯极限。
en_tdlr: This paper treats constant-step SGD with momentum as a nonlinear time series, proving geometric forgetting and the existence of a unique stationary causal solution for the joint parameter-momentum process, and deriving an invariance principle, a quenched Gaussian limit for averaged SGDM, and a Gaussian limit for the last iterate under small learning rates.
